notes.title: Security Update - Bug Patches
notes.content:

Updates to maps to stop exploiting.
Minor Bug fixes.

notes.title: Security Patch
notes.content:
Patched a function which hackers were using to kill everyone by ground. 

Added Colliders to oldtail creek to stop roof exploits.

notes.title: Hit Registration Fix
notes.content: Fixed disconnecting after hit registration fails.

notes.title: Bug Patch, Security Update
notes.content:
Fixed a couple small bugs.
Added some more security on the server.

notes.title: Major Security Update
notes.content: Added server side validation to protect against cheaters.

notes.title: Graphics Improvement Started - Patch update
notes.content:
Village map has been improved graphics wise
Fixed settings not showing on clients

notes.title: Invert Y Mouse and Slight Fixes
notes.content:
Added Invert Y mouse option
Fixed damage ui
Fixed cattail creek wall exploit
Made mute for chat and voice chat

notes.title: Small Patch Update
notes.content:
Load out no longer resets after games.
Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Optimization Improvements and Updates
notes.content:
Multiple optimization improvements done.
Volumetric Lights turned off by default.
Duplicate lobbies are now fixed.
Added EXPERIMENTAL casual queue system to match to region based lobbies.

Next we will be attempting to rewrite net code.

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
Deployable walls can not be stacked on destructables
Removed gun pads from sniper only
Optimization to cattail creek
fixed host migration pop up on joining lobbies

notes.title: New Leaderboard for TOP 100!
notes.content: Added a leaderboard to show the top players! Who's going to be the top?

Hide ghost lobbies in server list
Random map and gamemode on auto start

notes.content:
Low Graphics disable shadows
Fixed settings not saving skins
Fixed lobbies not displaying sometimes
Potentially fixed timing out of lobbies

notes.content:
Utils are now thrown faster.
ZR-10 Does more damage to shields and increased fire rate.

Movement buff.

Added auto start for lobbies.

Movement speed has been increased by 12%
Lobbies can now be ordered by ping, or player count.
Fixed an issue of lobbies not displaying.
Russian language is now supported.
